title: Lateral force restrictions.
officialText:
Gypsum board shall not be used in diaphragm ceilings to resist lateral forces imposed by
masonry or concrete construction.
SECTION BC 2509
GYPSUM BOARD IN SHOWERS AND WATER
CLOSETS
